parsed.change_summary: No changes were made to the code as the reported vulnerability (CWE-79) does not apply to this code fragment. The code does not output the formatted number in an HTML context, and there is no mechanism for injecting malicious scripts.
parsed.how_trigger_is_blocked: The trigger described in the finding no longer works because the code does not output the formatted number in an HTML context. The function `format_with_commas` only formats numbers with commas and returns a string that is printed to the console using `printf`. There is no mechanism for injecting malicious scripts into an HTML document.
